seo_title: Voice & Data Resale: Shopify Store | The Brandle
summary: A Shopify store for a UK IT asset recovery and data destruction business.

brief.label: IT asset recovery
brief.heading: The client
paras: Voice & Data Resale helps businesses and consumers recover value from retired technology: secure IT asset recovery, certified data destruction and refurbishment. The company says it has traded for over thirty years.
In other words, they were dealing with old office kit before most of it was old.

answer.label: Shopify store
answer.heading: What we built
paras: A Shopify storefront, designed and built. One half of the site sells refurbished IT and communications equipment. The other half is for businesses with kit to retire: asset disposal, data destruction and office clearances.
We have not published the scope, the timeline or any results for this one. When there are numbers we can stand behind, they will go here.
